title: Interop handoff lineage: v0.13 requirements versus v0.79 reality
summary: The preserved interop handoff targeted NoSQLServer v0.13 and required additive common status/operation aliases, transactions, prepared statements/batches, savepoints and metadata compatibility without copying PostgreSQL/MySQL internals. It is lineage, not the current baseline; v0.79 must be inspected for what has since landed.
invariants: Never use the old target version as current project identity.
Preserve the additive principle: shared database semantics do not require copying client-backed backend internals.
Capability queries are preferred to engine-name branching.

provenance.claim: Historical NoSQLServer interoperability handoff, explicitly targeting v0.13.
